segments.text: She is the owner of Cafe & Bar Amulette, which operates as a cafe during the day and a bar at night. She lives with her sister Kanon and cousin Rina in the house attached to the cafe.

After graduating from Oto Junior College, she worked as a singer, but after her parents' death, she quit and took over the cafe. She loved singing, but more than anything, she had a strong desire to protect the cafe, which was filled with memories of her parents.

She is serious and responsible, and is the type of person who tries to solve problems on her own. She has a calm personality and rarely gets emotional. She always acts while paying attention to her surroundings, and she tends to think of others before herself in everything she does.
She is childhood friends with Nami, and thinks of her as a reliable older sister. She wants to cherish the happy days she spends with Kanon, Nami, her cousin Rina, and Kyouko, who adores her.
昼はカフェ・夜はバーとして営業しているcafe＆bar　amuletteの店主。
妹の果音、従姉妹の梨那と３人で、お店と併設の自宅で暮らしている。
音短大を卒業したのち歌手として活動していたが、両親の死を機に辞めて店を継いだ。
歌うことは好きだったけれども、それ以上に両親との思い出が詰まっている店を自分の手で守りたいという気持ちが強かった。
真面目で責任感が強く、悩み事などは一人で解決しようとしてしまうタイプ。
穏やかな性格で、感情的になる事はほとんど無く、常に周囲に気を配りながら動き、何事も自分よりも相手の事を先に考えてしまう所がある。
奈実とは幼馴染みで、少し上の頼りになるお姉さんみたいに思っている。
果音や奈実、そして従妹の梨那や自分を慕ってくれる恭子などと過ごす幸せな日々を大切にしていきたいと思っている。

Shion's younger sister.
She attends a school in the neighborhood and is in the same grade as Kyouko.
Occasionally, she helps out at the shop, and along with Shion, they are adored by the customers as the 'sister duo.

She is good at housework and does many household tasks in place of Shion when she is at the store. Although she appears reliable in front of others, she still has a somewhat dependent side, and when she is alone with Shion, she feels the urge to cling close.
She temporarily attended the music class that Shion used to go to, where she became good friends with Kyouko. She is a childhood friend of Nami, and often played together with Shion.
詩音の妹。
近所の学園に通っていて、恭子とは同級生。
ときどきお店の手伝いもしていて、詩音と共に看板姉妹としてお客さん達に可愛がられている。
家事が得意で、店に出ている詩音の代わりに、いろいろと家のことをしている。
人前ではしっかりしているものの、まだ甘えん坊なところがあり、詩音と二人きりになると甘えたくなってくっついてしまう。
かつて詩音が通っていた音楽教室に、一時的に通っていたことがある。
恭子とはそこで仲良くなった。
奈実とは幼馴染みで、詩音に連れられてよく遊んで貰っていた。

Shion and Kanon’s maternal cousin.
Her family lives far away, and she is staying with the Yuzaki family to attend university.

While attending university, she also works as a magazine model. She’s sharp and composed while at school or work, but at home, she becomes lazy and slovenly. (And Kanon often scolds her for being a hindrance to cleaning.)
She is good at talking and gets along well with others, serving as a mood maker both at home and at university. People naturally gather around her.
She respects Shion, who supports the shop solidly despite being of a similar age, but she is concerned about Shion’s tendency to take on burdens alone.
詩音と果音の母方の従姉妹。
実家は遠方で、大学に通うために夕咲家に居候させてもらっている。
大学へ通う傍ら、雑誌のモデルとしても働いている。
大学にいる時や仕事中はシャキッとしているけれども、家ではずぼらなぐーたらになってしまう。
（そして、果音によく掃除の邪魔だと怒られる）
話し上手で人付き合いも良く、家でも大学でもムードメーカー的な存在。
自然と周囲に人が集まってくるタイプ。

She attends a local academy and is classmates with Kanon.
Although she has a flashy look typical of a gal, she is basically pure-hearted and rather dreamy.
She goes to the same music school that Shion and Kanon once attended, where she learns piano. She is serious, practices diligently, and stands out as the top student in the class.
Encouraged by her parents to join the music school, she heard Shion's singing and developed a longing for her. She has been practicing with the hope of playing piano along with Shion's songs someday.
After Shion quit being a singer to take over the family store, she decided to work hard to become a professional in Shion's place.
In her childhood, she occasionally received help from a church, where she often played with Nami.
She is planning to participate in this charity concert by playing the piano.
近所の学園に通っていて、果音とは同級生。
見た目は派手目なギャルだけれども、根は純情でわりと夢見がち。
かつて詩音や果音が通っていた音楽教室に通い、ピアノを習っている。
真面目で練習も人一倍熱心で、実力的には教室の中では頭一つ抜けている。
親の薦めで入った音楽教室で詩音の歌声を聞き、詩音に憧れを抱く。
いつか詩音の歌にあわせてピアノを弾きたいと思い、練習を続けてきた。
詩音が歌手を辞めて店を継いでからは、プロになって詩音の分も自分が頑張ろうと考えている。
幼いころに時々教会にお世話になっていて、その時に奈実とはよく遊んでもらっていた。
今回のチャリティーコンサートにはピアノで参加する予定。

She works as a nurse and helps her mother as a nun at home.
Her mother runs a church, and the facility on the premises also serves as a nursery school.
She is also active in charity work, and has taken over and continues to hold the annual charity concert that her mother used to organize.
Although she appears gentle and unreliable at first glance, she is actually a reliable person and is trusted by everyone.

She is childhood friends with Shion, Kano, and Kyouko, and after Shion and Kyouko met, the four of them often hang out together. She thinks of Shion, Kano, and Kyouko as her younger sisters and is very concerned about them.
Since Rina started living at Shion's house, she feels like she has a new little sister and is happy about it.
看護師として働きつつ、家ではシスターとして母の手伝いをしている。
母は教会を営んでおり、敷地内にある施設で保育所的な役割も担っている。
チャリティー活動にも熱心で、母が主催して行ってきた年に一度のチャリティーコンサートを、引き継ぎ続けている。
おっとりしていて一見頼りない印象だけれども、実はしっかり者で、みんなから信頼されている。

詩音や果音、恭子の事は妹のようにも思い、気にかけている。
梨那が詩音の家に住むようになってからは、妹が１人増えたように感じて、喜んでいる。

He has had a bad behavior since his school days, and ran away from home to live with a group of delinquents.
He doesn't hesitate to do illegal things for money. He also does fraudulent things and is good at pretending to be a "good guy".

He is currently refining illegal drugs in an abandoned facility at Nami's church that no one visits. He was doing his underground work smoothly, but he found out that there was talk of renovating the facility and turning it into an orphanage.
If the charity concert is successful, it seems that the talk of renovation will move forward in reality, so he thinks of infiltrating the facility as a volunteer and disrupting the concert.

He thinks that women can be bought with money and treats them like objects. He thinks that playing with amateur women is a different kind of fun than dealing with prostitutes, and he likes rough and intense sex.
Recently, he moved to the town where Shion and others live.

He had previously worked as a cook in a famous restaurant, but was fired due to his own insidious and twisted personality. After that, nothing he did went well, leading him to change jobs frequently, but recently he finally secured another job. It’s a place where he can live on-site, but both the workplace and his residence are still under construction, so in the meantime, he will work temporarily as a cook at Shion's shop.

At first, he was somewhat serious about his work, but he quickly began to slack off, and when Shion reprimanded him, he became resentful. Silently, he made a spare key to her home and began to invade her house, engaging in acts such as smelling her underwear.

Although he is not very familiar with women, he has an abnormally high pride and looks down on others. Having experienced setbacks, he harbors feelings of inferiority and enjoys engaging in insidious acts to confirm his own strength.
